# Pass 4 — Batch C: Annex K Consolidation and Schedule Adjudication

## Decision

Annex K has been consolidated into a derived constitutional runtime-security interface. It no longer contains incident, evidence, containment, logging, adversarial-evaluation, notice-delivery, platform-enforcement, or multi-agent operating procedure.

The controlled authority assignment is:

| Instrument | Status | Effect | Review State | Authority Role | Source Authority | Parent / basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Annex K | Active | Binding | Current | Constitutional Schedule Authority | Derived Authority | Delegated constitutional interface under AEON-001; cannot exceed its parent or SECURITY doctrine. |
| OPERATIONS-003 | Adopted | Operational | Current | Operational Authority | Derived Authority | Incident lifecycle and evidence procedure under OPERATIONS-001. |
| OPERATIONS-008 | Adopted | Operational | Current | Operational Authority | Derived Authority | Adversarial-evaluation procedure under OPERATIONS-001. |

The four Laws remain excluded. Their SHA-aware package is unchanged.

## Section disposition

| Former Annex K material | Disposition | Source of authority after consolidation |
|---|---|---|
| Signal clarification; tool and instruction-bearing content boundaries | Retained as constitutional interface | Annex K §§1.1–1.3 |
| Identity, mandate, credential, dependency, and emergent-pathway detail | Reduced to boundary inputs | SECURITY-001 classifies; constitutional execution schedules evaluate; OPERATIONS performs procedure. |
| Topology, multi-agent provenance, cascade, and orchestrator procedure | Reduced to continuity-of-signal requirement | SECURITY-001 and applicable OPERATIONS controls. |
| Adversarial-evaluation mutability, monitoring, artefact, and reachability detail | Reduced to boundary categories and routing | OPERATIONS-008; incidents and evidence route to OPERATIONS-003. |
| Notice modality, relational channel, platform trust labels, access review, limbo, and lockout procedure | Removed from Annex K as operational or domain procedure | OPERATIONS and the relevant LATTICE, SECURITY, and domain instruments. |
| Posture thresholds, transition cycles, logging, escalation, containment, and reclassification procedure | Removed from Annex K | SECURITY-001 classifications; OPERATIONS procedure; constitutional execution and ARBITRATION route outcomes. |
| `SEC.TBC` and `SECURITY.PM` | Retained as derived interface classifications | Annex K §§1.2 and 3; neither grants execution authority. |

## Non-bypass confirmation

Annex K now expressly cannot release or resolve a hold, approve intervention, create an exception, execute containment, or turn agreement, capability, credentials, evaluator status, access, or technical success into authority. Any such issue routes to the applicable constitutional execution, OPERATIONS, SECURITY, or ARBITRATION owner.

## Placement review

| Required element | Finding |
|---|---|
| Failure mechanism | Annex K retained operational detail after its authority was limited to a constitutional interface, creating duplicate procedure and an apparent alternate path to intervention. |
| Governance layer | Constitutional boundary interface with consequential operational and arbitral routing. |
| Instruments inspected | AEON-001; constitutional execution schedules; Annex K; SECURITY-001; OPERATIONS-001; OPERATIONS-003; OPERATIONS-008; ARBITRATION-001; LATTICE interfaces. |
| Source-authoritative instruments | SECURITY-001 for security doctrine; root constitutional instruments for boundaries; OPERATIONS-003 and OPERATIONS-008 for their respective procedures; ARBITRATION-001 for contested authority and scope. |
| Duplicate-authority risk | Resolved for the removed Annex K procedures. The remaining interface remains explicitly non-executing and derived. |
| Consequential updates | Annex K, OPERATIONS-003, OPERATIONS-008, their amendment ledgers, authority metadata, generated governance indexes, canonical-code projections, and metadata audit. |

## Remaining constitutional schedule work

This batch adjudicates Annex K only. The remaining constitutional schedules still require independent parent/delegation review before any broad metadata migration. No schedule is assumed source-authoritative merely because of its directory location.
